scope.comparison: Existing baseline file blobs vs current working files using Git hash-object --stdin-paths with repository clean/eol filters.
scope.claim: Git blob equivalence only; no claim of raw CRLF byte identity for repository text files.
scope.symlinks: Git blobs compare symlink link text, without hashing referenced target files.
scope.fileModes: Content equivalence does not certify executable mode changes; Git name-status changes are reported separately.
scope.execution: No tests, numerical calculations, fetch, staging, commits or desktop copying were performed by this helper.

originalTestsAndFixtures.intent: Changes are enumerated for independent review, not automatically approved.

reviewAndModelLimits.modelSelectorState: unknown; not exposed or verified by this helper
reviewAndModelLimits.humanReviewState: unknown; Git/file hashes cannot establish an actual human review
